title: Relay Briefing
unlockCriteria: Start Floor 6 and receive the Broadcast Relay briefing.
details: Unlocks when the Floor 6 defense director enters the first defended phase and latches the briefing goal.
directorFlavor: The renovation crew has arrived, the Broadcast Relay is still technically upright, and you have been briefed with the kind of confidence only a doomed production meeting can provide.

title: Opening Crew Wrapped
unlockCriteria: Clear the first Floor 6 defense wave.
details: Unlocks from the authoritative Floor 6 first-wave-cleared objective projection.
directorFlavor: The first crew made noise, paperwork, and a legally useful amount of dust. You made them leave the set.

title: Plinth Occupied
unlockCriteria: Build a Floor 6 tower on an authored maintenance plinth.
details: Unlocks only after a legal Floor 6 tower build transaction occupies an authored site.
directorFlavor: At last, a maintenance plinth is doing something other than looking expensive in the background.

title: Change Order Approved
unlockCriteria: Purchase a Floor 6 run-scoped upgrade offer.
details: Unlocks from the Floor 6 upgrade transaction ledger after an offer is selected exactly once.
directorFlavor: A change order has been approved, which means the budget is fake but the paperwork is real.

title: Service Break Secured
unlockCriteria: Exit a Floor 6 service break with hostile activity cleared.
details: Unlocks once the Floor 6 break-cleanup path exits a safe build break.
directorFlavor: A safe service break with no hostile activity: a miracle, or at least a quiet minute the sponsors can sell.

title: Deadline Defeated
unlockCriteria: Defeat the Broadcast Deadline finale encounter.
details: Unlocks from the authoritative Floor 6 finale boss-defeated latch.
directorFlavor: The Broadcast Deadline came due, looked at the Relay, looked at you, and discovered an exciting new definition of overdue.

title: Hold for Renovation
unlockCriteria: Secure the Broadcast Relay and complete the Floor 6 objective.
details: Unlocks only when the Floor 6 defense quest is complete and the run ends in the authoritative victory state.
directorFlavor: Against every planning memo, demolition invoice, and ratings-friendly complication, the Broadcast Relay is secured. Renovation may now proceed in whatever sense that word still applies.
